class.name: GodotDoctorValidationSuiteValidationCollection
class.brief_description: A collection mapping [GodotDoctorValidationSuite] instances to their scene and resource validation collections. Used by [GodotDoctorCLIValidationCollector] to aggregate results across all suites during a CLI validation run.

method.name: add_scene_validations_collection
method.description: Adds [param scene_validation_collection] for [param validation_suite] to this collection. Fails if [param validation_suite] already has a scene validation collection.

method.name: add_resource_validations_collection
method.description: Adds [param resource_validation_collection] for [param validation_suite] to this collection. Fails if [param validation_suite] already has a resource validation collection.

method.name: get_validation_suite_to_scene_validation_collection_map
method.description: Returns the map of [GodotDoctorValidationSuite] instances to their [GodotDoctorSceneValidationCollection]s.

method.name: get_validation_suite_to_resource_validation_collection_map
method.description: Returns the map of [GodotDoctorValidationSuite] instances to their [GodotDoctorResourceValidationCollection]s.

members.member: A dictionary mapping each [GodotDoctorValidationSuite] to its [GodotDoctorSceneValidationCollection].
A dictionary mapping each [GodotDoctorValidationSuite] to its [GodotDoctorResourceValidationCollection].
